answer: Because the echo pair is tracked in the comet ledger, the forge audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 52 identities means 52 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. Full reward needs answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 27%. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
